name: Hangzhou Silan Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Silan Microelectronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of electronic components in China. It offers discrete devices, including LVMOS, HVMOS, IGBT, SiC, and diode; IPM products; industrial and automobile IGBT modules; AC-DC and DC-DC converters; fast charging ICs; and LED lighting drivers, such as dimming and non-dimming LED lighting, LED headlight, and automotive low-voltage motor drivers, as well as smart power switches. The company also provides three-phase and singe half bridge drivers, as well as PFC IGBT gate driver; MEMS sensor comprising triaxial acceleration, six-axis inertial, proximity detection…
